newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bond market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bond market closing report.

text.p: Swiss bonds ended a very quiet day slightly lower, taking a cue from German and U.S. markets with little in the domestic market to disturb the calm.

Swiss bonds may be watching the trend in currencies, with a stronger Swiss franc arguing for lower Swiss short-term rates. Some investors may also be waiting for the Swiss parliament to decide on a 561 million Swiss franc investment package this week, although economists doubted the pact would provide a major stimulus for the economy. Swiss regional governments are expected to provide additional funds which could boost the package, if approved, to just over two billion francs.
Euro Swiss francs up one at 98.17.
